claim: Determine whether a fresh LLM can understand and operate the current native game interface with the player CLI.
material_proof: Cite current native observations, action receipts, resulting player state, and any missing information or contradictions encountered during freely chosen waiting and nested-interface interaction. Report save and exit outcomes honestly. This is harness usability diagnosis only, with zero product-feature credit.
current_uncertainty: Whether current state presentation, action discovery, transport bookkeeping and witness retrieval suffice without source-code archaeology.
forbidden_shortcuts: manufacturing game state or gameplay results
treating accepted input as its unobserved game outcome
honest_stop_conditions: the usability question is settled with cited observations or a concrete missing capability
native input ownership or binding is unavailable
